title: AI-powered VR avatars in Unreal with conversation and scene actions
author: Western_Bug_5085
selftext:
Hi everyone,

Yesterday we shared a quick tutorial on integrating actions for AI avatars inside Unreal Engine. We’re taking that workflow into VR now with a new Unreal Engine VR tutorial.

The setup is built around a MetaHuman integrated with Convai inside a VR template project. The AI is used for hands-free conversation, scene awareness, and action requests, while the Unreal project handles the actual world-side behavior.

In this example, the character can talk naturally in VR, follow the player, and interact contextually with scene objects using Convai Actions.

Full tutorial:  
[https://youtu.be/89GB5tHFzyk](https://youtu.be/89GB5tHFzyk)

Convai Actions tutorial in case you missed it:  
[https://youtu.be/yWqJQRttoEI](https://youtu.be/yWqJQRttoEI)

We loved seeing the positive response on the previous post. Keep the feedback coming in and also let us know how AI game devs are approaching this split between AI intent and game logic, especially for VR characters that need to understand context and perform actions inside the scene.
